Name: Orange Hats (CP and FS)
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
Adds two oranges you can put on your head.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/XWCvNtx/hats.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Orange Hat
[*]Orange Blossom Hat
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/MGL3tgc/requirements-1.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿, depending on the version you choose
[*]SMAPI﻿
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZW8hY5N/installation-1.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install Content Patcher or Fashion Sense, and SMAPI.
[*]Unzip ﻿[CP] Seasonal Hats.zip or [FS] Seasonal Hats.zip into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]For the Content Patcher version, hats can be purchased at the Hat Mouse by default. This can be reconfigured to nearly any shop in the game via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿.
[*]For the Fashion Sense version, hats can be found in the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror.[/url]﻿
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/s1Z754v/credits-1.png[/img]
Mods in screenshots:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23504]Orangeblossom's Sundresses[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21767]HxW Farmers Market Furniture - Wildflour Set[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16717]HxW Greenhouse Furniture[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8164]Simple Foliage﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]

If something has gone wrong, I [b]need[/b] a SMAPI log to help you. See smapi.io/log for instructions.
It is not possible to troubleshoot without a log. Thank you for helping me help you!
